# FG-CI-0027

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_project_may_have_at_most_twenty_schedules` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このプロジェクトの定期実行は上限（20 件）に達しています。使っていない定期実行を消してから作ってください。
- en: This project already has the most pipeline schedules allowed (20). Delete one you no longer use, then create it.
- id: Proyek ini sudah memiliki jadwal pipeline maksimum (20). Hapus jadwal yang tidak dipakai, lalu buat lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C12: a project may have at most 20 pipeline schedules (`forge_db::ci_schedules::MAX_PER_PROJECT`), counted under the project's lock in the transaction that would create the 21st. A schedule is a standing load on the runners; the bound keeps one project from filling the queue. Not a fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `project_id`, `schedules` (the count) and `max`. Read: SELECT id, description, active FROM forge.ci_pipeline_schedules WHERE project_id = <id> ORDER BY id;

## 対処 (fix)

Delete or reuse an existing schedule (an inactive one still counts).
